errors.source_evidence: The original PDF page organizes the six key data points as large individual blocks with bold yellow percentages and descriptive text underneath, arranged visually in two rows of three columns, centered on a decorative background graphic.
errors.html_evidence: In HTML, the data points are represented as a simple bulleted list followed by a table, both lacking the large bold styling, yellow coloring, and side-by-side visual grouping seen in the PDF.
errors.correction: Implement the six key data points as visually distinct blocks with large yellow percentage text above corresponding descriptions arranged in two rows and three columns, resembling the PDF's design rather than a simple list and table.

errors.source_evidence: A horizontal yellow line is shown below the heading 'Employer focus on economic value is driving fundamental changes in brokers’ roles.'

errors.correction: Use a solid yellow horizontal line underline as in the PDF, spanning a visually noticeable width under the heading, to match the source styling.

errors.source_evidence: The PDF includes a dark background image with plants and an office environment behind the data points in Figure 7 area.
errors.html_evidence: No background image behind the data points or any decorative backgrounds are included in the HTML rendering.
errors.correction: Include the background image with dark overlay behind the data points section to visually match the PDF's style and emphasis.

errors.source_evidence: The PDF presents the 'Percent of employers and the data they seek' data visually as numeric blocks, not as a formal table.
